desc:
Welcome to 2 Player Fish Tycoon - Extend your dock to partner with as many fishing companies as possible, each partnership will drive profit and new species to your Fishery! 

🐟 Build a Fishery and Extend your Dock to unlock rare fish & partnerships!
🏝️ Visit the Merchants Cove for Rewards!
🏁 Play through the Smugglers Cave Obby to gain Frenzy Time!
🔥 Survive waves of Pirate Attacks eager to steal your profits!
⭐ Rebirth to unlock Rare & Powerful Rewards!
🕹️ Multiplayer, this game can be played with TWO players! Bring a friend!

👍 Don't forget to favorite & thumbs up if you enjoyed! ⭐

🔔 Hit the 'FOLLOW' button to get notified of updates!  🔔

💾 This game has autosave.

👑Don't forget to also join Royal Prime as you usually get special bonuses in all our games for JUST being a member:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/7900165/Royal-Prime#!/about
